verdict.rationale: Orb ships an extensive documented public API covering subscription creation/edits, event ingestion, idempotency, cursor pagination, error responses, alerts, webhooks, and cached responses, plus official SDKs in six languages, all detailed in first-party API reference docs. missing for 10: a discoverable OpenAPI/swagger spec (probe returned 404 on all candidate paths) and independent/hands-on developer corroboration of API usage.
